name: Series
description: Represents a series in a chart.
remarks: The Series object is a member of the SeriesCollection collection.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: AxisGroup
properties.description: Returns or sets the group for the specified series. Read/write.

properties.name: ErrorBars
properties.description: Returns an ErrorBars object that represents the error bars for the series. Read-only.

properties.name: Explosion
properties.description: Returns or sets the explosion value for a pie-chart or doughnut-chart slice. Returns 0 (zero) if there's no explosion (the tip of the slice is in the center of the pie). Read/write Long.

properties.name: Formula
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value that represents the object's formula in A1-style notation and in the language of the macro.

properties.name: FormulaLocal
properties.description: Returns or sets the formula for the object, using A1-style references in the language of the user. Read/write String.

properties.name: FormulaR1C1
properties.description: Returns or sets the formula for the object, using R1C1-style notation in the language of the macro. Read/write String.

properties.name: FormulaR1C1Local
properties.description: Returns or sets the formula for the object, using R1C1-style notation in the language of the user. Read/write String.

properties.name: HasDataLabels
properties.description: True if the series has data labels. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: HasErrorBars
properties.description: True if the series has error bars. This property isn't available for 3D charts. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: InvertIfNegative
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel inverts the pattern in the item when it corresponds to a negative number. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MarkerBackgroundColor
properties.description: Sets the marker background color as an RGB value or returns the corresponding color index value. Applies only to line, scatter, and radar charts. Read/write Long.

properties.name: MarkerBackgroundColorIndex
properties.description: Returns or sets the marker background color as an index into the current color palette, or as one of the following XlColorIndex constants: xlColorIndexAutomatic or xlColorIndexNone. Applies only to line, scatter, and radar charts. Read/write Long.

properties.name: MarkerForegroundColor
properties.description: Sets the marker foreground color as an RGB value or returns the corresponding color index value. Applies only to line, scatter, and radar charts. Read/write Long.

properties.name: MarkerForegroundColorIndex
properties.description: Returns or sets the marker foreground color as an index into the current color palette, or as one of the following XlColorIndex constants: xlColorIndexAutomatic or xlColorIndexNone. Applies only to line, scatter, and radar charts. Read/write Long.

properties.name: MarkerSize
properties.description: Returns or sets the data-marker size, in points. Can be a value from 2 through 72. Read/write Long.

properties.name: MarkerStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets the marker style for a point or series in a line chart, scatter chart, or radar chart. Read/write XlMarkerStyle.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value representing the name of the object.

properties.name: PictureType
properties.description: Returns or sets an XlChartPictureType value that represents the way pictures are displayed on a column or bar picture chart.

properties.name: PlotOrder
properties.description: Returns or sets the plot order for the selected series within the chart group. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Smooth
properties.description: True if curve smoothing is turned on for the line chart or scatter chart. Applies only to line and scatter charts. Read/write.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long value that represents the series type.

properties.name: ChartType
properties.description: Returns or sets the chart type. Read/write XlChartType.

properties.name: Values
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents a collection of all the values in the series.

properties.name: XValues
properties.description: Returns or sets an array of x values for a chart series. The XValues property can be set to a range on a worksheet or to an array of values, but it cannot be a combination of both. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: BubbleSizes
properties.description: Returns or sets a string that refers to the worksheet cells containing the x-value, y-value, and size data for the bubble chart. When you return the cell reference, it will return a string describing the cells in A1-style notation. To set the size data for the bubble chart, you must use R1C1-style notation. Applies only to bubble charts. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: BarShape
properties.description: Returns or sets the shape used with the 3D bar or column chart. Read/write XlBarShape.

properties.name: ApplyPictToSides
properties.description: True if a picture is applied to the sides of the point or all points in the series. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ApplyPictToFront
properties.description: True if a picture is applied to the front of the point or all points in the series. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ApplyPictToEnd
properties.description: True if a picture is applied to the end of the point or all points in the series. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Has3DEffect
properties.description: True if the series has a three-dimensional appearance. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Shadow
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean value that determines if the object has a shadow.

properties.name: HasLeaderLines
properties.description: True if the series has leader lines. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: LeaderLines
properties.description: Returns a LeaderLines object that represents the leader lines for the series. Read-only.

properties.name: PictureUnit2
properties.description: Returns or sets the unit for each picture on the chart if the PictureType property is set to xlStackScale (if not, this property is ignored). Read/write Double.

properties.name: Format
properties.description: Returns the ChartFormat object. Read-only.

properties.name: PlotColorIndex
properties.description: Returns an index value that is used internally to associate series formatting with chart elements. Read-only.

properties.name: InvertColor
properties.description: Returns or sets the fill color for negative data points in a series. Read/write.

properties.name: InvertColorIndex
properties.description: Returns or sets the fill color for negative data points in a series. Read/write.

properties.name: IsFiltered
properties.description: This setting controls whether the series has been filtered out from the chart. The default value is False. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ParentDataLabelOption
properties.description: Specifies the parent data label option (banner, overlapping, or none) for the specified series within the chart group. Read/write XlParentDataLabelOptions.

properties.name: QuartileCalculationInclusiveMedian
properties.description: True if the series uses an inclusive median quartile calculation method. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: GeoProjectionType
properties.description: Specifies the geography projection type for the specified series within the chart group. Read/write XlGeoProjectionType.

properties.name: GeoMappingLevel
properties.description: Specifies the geography mapping level for the specified series within the chart group. Read/write XlGeoMappingLevel.

methods.name: ClearFormats
methods.description: Clears the formatting of the object.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: If the series has a picture fill, this method copies the picture to the Clipboard.

methods.name: DataLabels
methods.description: Returns an object that represents either a single data label (a DataLabel object) or a collection of all the data labels for the series (a DataLabels collection).

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The number of the data label.

methods.name: ErrorBar
methods.signature: ErrorBar(Direction As XlErrorBarDirection, Include As XlErrorBarInclude, Type As XlErrorBarType, [Amount As Variant], [MinusValues As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Applies error bars to the series. Variant.

parameters.name: Include
parameters.description: The error bar parts to include.

parameters.name: Amount
parameters.description: The error amount. Used for only the positive error amount when _Type_ is xlErrorBarTypeCustom.

parameters.name: MinusValues
parameters.description: The negative error amount when _Type_ is xlErrorBarTypeCustom.

methods.name: Paste
methods.description: Pastes a picture from the Clipboard as the marker on the selected series.

methods.name: Points
methods.description: Returns an object that represents a single point (a Point object) or a collection of all the points (a Points collection) in the series. Read-only.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The name or number of the point.

methods.name: Trendlines
methods.description: Returns an object that represents a single trendline (a Trendline object) or a collection of all the trendlines (a Trendlines collection) for the series.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The name or number of the trendline.

methods.name: ApplyDataLabels
methods.signature: ApplyDataLabels([Type As XlDataLabelsType], [LegendKey As Variant], [AutoText As Variant], [HasLeaderLines As Variant], [ShowSeriesName As Variant], [ShowCategoryName As Variant], [ShowValue As Variant], [ShowPercentage As Variant], [ShowBubbleSize As Variant], [Separator As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Applies data labels to a series.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of data label to apply.

parameters.name: LegendKey
parameters.description: True to show the legend key next to the point. The default value is False.

parameters.name: AutoText
parameters.description: True if the object automatically generates appropriate text based on content.

parameters.name: HasLeaderLines
parameters.description: For the Chart and Series objects, True if the series has leader lines.

parameters.name: ShowSeriesName
parameters.description: Pass a Boolean value to enable or disable the series name for the data label.

parameters.name: ShowCategoryName
parameters.description: Pass a Boolean value to enable or disable the category name for the data label.

parameters.name: ShowValue
parameters.description: Pass a Boolean value to enable or disable the value for the data label.

parameters.name: ShowPercentage
parameters.description: Pass a Boolean value to enable or disable the percentage for the data label.

parameters.name: ShowBubbleSize
parameters.description: Pass a Boolean value to enable or disable the bubble size for the data label.

parameters.name: Separator
parameters.description: The separator for the data label.

methods.name: SetProperty
methods.signature: SetProperty(ID As String, Value As Variant)
